$comment: Copy check config for scripts/check-copy.mjs (docs/REDESIGN-PLAN.md §7 'Copy check'; owner decisions W1, W2, W5, W7, W9).
An entry is a string (the term) or { term, why?, allowOn?, caseSensitive?, plural?, upper?, exactlyOnce? }.

Both lists are scanned over the built output (pages, text route bodies, public/ text files, *.alt.txt) AND over every src string literal / template text / JSX text (most interactive copy is client-only and never reaches the HTML).
text: case-insensitive, whole word. names: case-sensitive plus the ALL-CAPS spelling; a version suffix ('Qwen3', 'GPT4o') or a CamelCase compound ('MeshtasticPKI') still matches.
Whitespace in a term also matches none ('64 KB' = '64KB'); a term ending in three lowercase letters also matches its plural (set plural: true for 'Hub').
allowOn: ids where the term is fine: a route ('/terms') or a source path / glob ('src/app/terms/**'); '*' = everywhere.
requiredFiles: routes/files that must exist in the build output. mustContain: texts that must appear on a route ({NAME} = a src/lib/site.ts constant).

legacy: what the not-yet-replaced legacy frame still renders. Phase agents do NOT edit this file: after each phase the orchestrator deletes the entries the report lists under 'NOTE legacy entries no longer needed'.
